checks.check: protocol versions the installed MCP SDK can negotiate
the negotiated protocol version is recorded for a stdio server
tools/list: RigorRun sees every tool the server offers
tools/call, and normalisation that follows the result shape
a refused call is an error, never data
a structured result is read as records
JSON inside a text block is records (R-8)
isError results and JSON-RPC errors are errors, not data
a call past its timeout is an error, not an empty result
a server writing 200 KB to stderr is still answered
close() settles and ends the stdio child after a blocked call
a server that speaks only 2026-07-28 is refused at connect, visibly
